2. Connectivity: Works offline in remote rural veredas; queues outbox.
3. Limited Scope: User sees ONLY own farms / trips; small blast radius.
4. Compensating Controls: Hardware keystore outbox encryption (ASM-095),
device_id binding, local screen lock, server-side scope enforcement.

div.div:
ARCHITECTURAL ISOLATION GATE (Security §8.4, Sack & Trip §10):
• The buyer view is a separate physical projection store (buyer_view table).
• Lookup IAM role holds grants ONLY on buyer_view and public_view KMS key.
• A coding error in the lookup service CANNOT return fields from transactional,
personal, or telemetry stores because IAM and KMS deny access at infrastructure level.

div.div:
DATA WITHHOLDING INVARIANTS (Security §8.2, §8.3):
EXACTLY 4 GROUPS RETURNED:
1. Origin: sack_code, department, municipality (coarse geography only).
2. Processing Dates: drying_start_date, drying_end_date, packing_date (calendar dates, no times).
3. Status: current sack state (in preparation, en route center, center accepted/rejected, en route port, port accepted/rejected).
4. Drying Variables: final_coffee_moisture_pct, grain_temperature_min/mean/max_c.
STRICTLY WITHHELD (NEVER EXPOSED):
• Farmer name, cédula, phone, subject_id.
• Farm name, coordinates, polygon, vereda.
• Farm node IDs, raw telemetry series.
• Transporter identity, vehicle plate, trip ID, positions.
• Custody event timestamps, weights, collection center, rejection reasons, pest records.

div.div:
TIME LIMITS & RECOVERY (Scenario 3A):
• SLA Target: Revocation completed within 4 hours of report (ASM-098).
• Disconnection: Active TLS sessions killed within minutes of leaving ACTIVE (PD-100).
• Edge Buffer Expiry: Node buffer expires after 24 hours on device (ASM-074).
• S3 URL Expiry: Drone upload pre-signed URLs expire after 15 minutes (ASM-093).
• Replacement: Replacement node receives new CSR-registered X.509 certificate.

div.div:
IMMEDIATE REVOCATION ENFORCEMENT (§3.3, §10):
• Zero Token Wait: Token revoked_after comparison terminates access in 0 minutes.
Does NOT wait for standard 60-minute access token expiration!
• Identity Preserved: User account is disabled, NOT deleted, so historical flight orders
and fumigation authorizations preserve a valid operator_id for auditability.

div.div:
FIELD PHONE LOSS & SIM HIJACK PROTECTION (§10):
• Immediate device_id Revocation: Outbox queue on lost phone is permanently rejected.
• AdminDisableUser: Critical protection against SIM swap or thief intercepting SMS OTP.
• In-Person Re-Enrollment: User MUST verify identity in person at Collection Center
before account is re-enabled on a replacement smartphone.
